verdict.rationale: Muse documents that once a goal or task is set it keeps working on a schedule and in response to events. It tracks these in a Goals tab and keeps monitoring and following up after the app is closed, which amounts to agent-driven recurring work. There is no evidence of user-defined recurring schedules, such as cron-style timing, recurrence rules, or a workflow scheduler. Missing for 10: explicit user-configurable recurrence and timing controls, documentation of scheduled-workflow management, independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably.
